original.target_description: Unresolved target: identity integration/consolidation in relation to negative emotionality. Located Table 3 negative-emotionality regressions on EM/PG and Table 4 identity regressions on EM/PG; no direct negative-emotionality-to-identity-integration test identified.

replication.target_description: Unassigned replication side; not examined in this source-grouped completion.

notes: PDF page 9 (printed p. 1003) rendered and visually checked. Table 4 predicts identity integration and acceptance from Environmental Mastery (EM), Personal Growth (PG), and EM x PG; it does not give a trait-to-integration test for either supplied trait description. Table 4 standardized integration coefficients are .22 (EM), .27 (PG), and -.04 (interaction), with N = 96; stars on .22 and .27 denote p < .05. These are candidate neighboring tests only, not assigned target values. Figure 2 instead links Capacity for Status at age 21 to Identity Integration at age 43 (.44, p < .05; N = 94). Figure 3 links Openness/complexity at age 21 to Identity Acceptance at age 43 (-.50, p < .05; N = 94). The two distinct identity dimensions are defined in Methods, pp. 999–1000. No coefficient conversion, N arithmetic, or inference from df was performed. All candidate Ns count women/participants in the named analyses; target-specific exclusions cannot be established. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders. Table 3 (p. 1002) gives negative-emotionality standardized weights -.48 for EM, .17 for PG, .09 for their interaction, and N = 76. Only -.48 is starred (p < .05). These do not predict identity integration. Figure 2 integration is predicted by Capacity for Status, not negative emotionality. Neither those results nor Table 4 can be assigned to the supplied relationship.
